about:
M & S Fabricators operates from Lorton, Virginia, where it was founded in 2001. The company provides customized sheet metal fabrication services to contractors in the surrounding area.

The shop specializes in HVAC sheet metal fabrication, producing ductwork and a wide range of fittings such as elbows, reducers, dampers, diffusers, and boots. Its in-house processes include bending with press brakes and hydraulic brakes, cutting with nibblers, band saws, and shears, forming via roll forming, shearing, laser cutting, beading, and the operation of TDC, snaplock, and Pittsburg machines. The facility handles materials including heavy-gauge steel, stainless steel, TDC-Duct-Mate, grease duct, and welded assemblies.

M & S Fabricators serves residential and commercial contractors, supplying fabricated ductwork and accessories for HVAC installations in both single-family homes and commercial buildings. Its customer base includes local contractors who rely on the shop for custom fittings and duct components.

The company emphasizes craftsmanship and efficiency, stating that its experienced professionals understand the complex details behind every project and are committed to surpassing client expectations on every job.
